title: Intense tunneling under Clarkdale shook homes, residents compensated

tellings.quote: And one of the things we heard about from locals was that 20 years ago the drilling was so intense that things were shaking on the bookshelves and they were obviously tunneling underneath the village at Clarkdale where these people live.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 about what he believes is a hidden UFO base in Arizona, says locals in the small town of Clarkdale told him a story. According to them, about 20 years earlier, around 2005, drilling under the village was so intense that things shook on their bookshelves. Coulthart takes this as a sign that someone was tunneling beneath their homes, which would fit his idea of a secret underground site nearby.
